name: Dessau, Dialled
tagline: A Bauhaus poster over a working body: each page's name set large beside a square of its ink, one round green tube drawing that page's own data (a 28-day dial on Home, a leaf on Plans, a meter on Status, nine parts on Settings), and rows in the poster's four shapes.
concept: The line keeps its Bauhaus poster: a big sentence-case name, a square of section ink, one green primary and one round phosphor tube. Every circle now draws real data and nothing else. Home has a true 28-day dial whose rim is lit only from now to the next plan. Plans has a calendar leaf, Status a square-root meter, To do an amber LATE, Ideas a numbered map and Settings nine segments, one per part. Around the tubes the page is a calm, matte printed poster in section inks, wheat figures and clay for the family, and the only light is the machine reporting.
companions: Steel-cyan #86b4ba (Plans) is on the head squares, the 4px column caps at 75%, the strip labels, the head link 'All plans', the starter key's square and, new, the dial's waypoint rings that are not next (a matte plans ink on the glass, so only the next ring is green). Denim #90a8cc (To do) and heather, now lifted to #a88ad0 (Ideas), take the same places: caps, squares, labels, head links, the Ideas row numerals and the form's margin rule. Wheat #dcc58f is for every strip figure, the day numeral in Coming up's date line ('SUN 4 OCT') and the meter's written figures. Bone #e6e0d4 at 88% sets the poster and TODAY. Clay #c58b6b marks restaurants and the Family/Memory squares, and #bf9d80 caps the family's chat bubbles. Pewter #5d6469 is now the ask box's border at rest, the dial's grid, track and day ticks, the dashed run, past days' rings in the month, off lamps and the meter's track (#7d868c); #9aa5ae marks the dial's week ticks and labels and the Settings/Status squares. Steel #7f93a3 is the setup bar and its first step, Settings' eight lit segments and the strip's needs-a-look square. Amber is late only: the LATE cell, late rows, the meter's limit tick, the To do tube's 3 and the 'Needs a look' words. Kinds: activity wheat #cdb27a, restaurant clay, outing sage #8fc29b, trip steel #86a9c9, show brick-rose #c4898f, day trip pewter-teal #859f99, and seasonal moved to an olive #a8a86c. A warm stone #cfc6b4 replaces the blue-grey accent of the pages that have no colour of their own.
decisions: Revised in place from the first draft. Palette: palettes/x14b-dessau-cross.json. Variant: variants/x14b-dessau-cross/ (sheet.css; templates home, _ask, _ui, base, ideas, idea_form (new), plans, plans_month, settings, status, tasks). removed.txt is empty.

Home's dial geometry was re-cut so its light reads in a still. The rings sit on r78 and the lit rim runs on r96, about 10px outside them, so nothing covers it. The lit stretch is a 4px near-white phosphor core with the kit's layers (drop-shadows at 2, 7 and 16px) over a blurred 12-unit halo stroke, and ends in a hot dot at the next ring's angle. The afterglow wedge goes from 14% to 44% phosphor over 40 degrees, masked off the hub. The hand runs from the hub edge to the rim. Week ticks cross the rim at 90/180/270, and their 1w/2w/3w labels sit inside, between the hub and the ring band, at about 18px VT323 in pewter-ink. The day angles are still days_out/28*360, computed from the app clock.

The dial's grid, track, hub ring and day ticks are pewter. The rings that are not next are steel-cyan, the same ring the Coming up rows carry. Only the hand, the lit arc and the next ring glow. The bezel's lighter top border is dimmed to pewter at 40% and the glass sheen removed, so no grey arc reads as a second light.

Coming up rows take back the diary date as a second line in label caps, 'SUN 4 OCT · in 2 days', with the day figure in wheat (tabular) and the relative words in dim lower case. Rings that are not next are drawn in --plans at 60%.

Green moved to ground (principle 3, colour replaced, not removed). The ask box's border is pewter at rest and phosphor only on :focus-within. Head links ('All plans', 'All 4', 'Add an idea', 'All 12') are set in their column's ink. Heather is lifted to #a88ad0, which also takes the ideas~todo pair from 2.7 to 5.5 ΔE under deuteranopia. Seasonal moves to olive (restaurant~seasonal goes from 8.8 to 15.4 typical) and the accent to warm stone (home~todo goes from 9.3 to 14). The typical-sight kind and section floors now all pass.

Settings joins the one-window-per-page system. Its tube is now nine rim segments, one per part in list order from twelve o'clock: eight lit steel with a soft steel glow, and a dark gap where Sign-in and security sits. The glass reads '8 of 9' in VT323 with IN ORDER under it in label caps. No green lights a warning. The strip's Sign-in cell carries the steel square, the label in label ink and 'Needs a look' in amber words at the row step.

Ideas: the 1fr/22rem grid starts at the page head, so the sticky map fills the band beside the name. Each row is led by its number in VT323 (1.3rem, since VT323 runs small) in heather, before the kind square. The map's numbers sit on the side away from north-south (flipped near the rim so none clips) and fan down on thin leader lines when another number is already there. The rotating sweep, an angle that reported nothing, is gone. 'Save a thought for later' is a quiet graphite key on the views bar, no longer a floating panel.

Status: the meter's track is 2px pewter, $0 is labelled at its start (outside the needle's rest), and the ghost needle is 1.5px dashed at 55% phosphor, longer than the live needle (its tip at r86 against r64). '$0.00 TODAY' sits in the lower third, clear of both the needle and the bezel. Every page's tube is now one size (up to 13.5rem). The heads align with the rows' text edge, so the 01/02/03 folios and the lamps hang together in the margin column.

Plans: a second lede line fills the dead band ('Then Mount St. Helens day trip, Friday 9 October, 09:00, and 2 more this month.' on the month; the list says how many more after). In the month, past days' rings are 1px pewter with dim figures, the grid numerals are Outfit 300 tabular, and plan titles wrap to two lines at the small step instead of being cut off (an old negative-margin rule was clipping them).

Form (New idea): the name is set at --t-page (64px) with the full 32px heather square, like every other page. The empty right half becomes a margin: 'Kinds so far', each kind as its filled square, icon and caps word in its own ink, with 'Or name a new one; it gets a spark of its own.' under them. It shows the colour system and the free-kind rule in one place.

Bare links at rest: 'Choose your own password', Plans' lede link and Status's 'Change a key' have no underline at rest, and a 2px underline in the section ink on :hover and :focus-visible. Prose help links keep 1px.
Phone: the mini tube shortens 'tomorrow' to 'in 1 d' so it stays on the glass. The box is pewter at rest there too. The wordmark is in the bar.
title: Tell Vera. / Let’s *plan.* It says FamilyDB's job: you tell Vera what the family wants, she turns it into a plan. The lit word is the work itself, and it sits directly over the box where you tell her.
measures: Final full render: 0 hard checks failed, 2 guidelines missed: the page's words (plans 32.9% differ, from the leaf, the 'Then...' lede and the strip), and the restaurant~seasonal pair at 4.4 ΔE under deuteranopia (guideline 5). Every typical-sight kind and section distance now passes 12 (the draft missed four colour guidelines). ink_on_bg 14.25:1, brand_on_bg 15.1:1, brand #6dff9c unchanged. Green share of colour: home 68.1% (draft 73.2), ideas 59.7% (70.0), chat 73.3% (73.3), status 76.3% (77.0). Hue entropy: home 0.47 (0.41), ideas 0.49 (0.40), chat 0.31, status 0.24. No page has a target under 44px (home, home-phone, plans, status, ideas, todo, chat, settings, form, general, login, lost: all 0). Smallest text 12px (11.97 on General's code line). No sideways scroll.
strengths: Every page's circle now draws its own data: Home a true 28-day dial, Plans a leaf, Status a square-root meter with ghost and limit, To do an amber LATE, Ideas a numbered map beside the list, and Settings nine segments with the missing part dark. 'Poster plus badge' becomes one system: one round window per page.

The dial's light reports in a still. Only the stretch from now to the next plan is lit, on a rim of its own outside the rings; the afterglow trails the hand. The grid and the rings that are not next are matte (pewter, steel-cyan), so the light is wired to what it reports, inside the tube rather than as another rail.
The Phosphor kit's light sits where the machine speaks: 'plan.' with halo and scanlines, the dial's arc and hand, the leaf's 4, the amber 3, the meter's needle. Everything else is grounded ink.

Typesetting: sentence-case names at one page step everywhere, the form included, and Coming up's diary line 'SUN 4 OCT · in 2 days' with wheat figures. Status's folios and lamps hang in a margin column. The month has light tabular numerals and titles wrapped, not cut.
Colour distances: every typical-sight kind and section pair is now 12 or more, and heather is far enough from denim for deuteranopes.
No target under 44px on any page; the Ideas map's dot links are 46px.
weaknesses: Green share is still above the brief's 55-60% on Home (68%), Chat (73%) and Status (76%). Home's biggest green masses are the parts the motif needs: 'plan.' with its kit halo, the Send button and the dial. Chat keeps her scanlined, edge-lit bubbles and the glyph tube. Status has almost no colour at all (0.5% of pixels), so a few live lamps dominate the ratio.

The New idea form's Kind stays a free-text field with the browser's list of kinds, not a select (declined, see revisions). The margin key shows each kind's square and ink, but the field itself takes no colour when a kind is chosen.
Month plan chips still use the plans ink, not the kind's: the month view has no kind for an entry.
In the Ideas map's south-of-home cluster the dots themselves still overlap (they are true positions). The numbers fan out on leaders, but their 46px hit circles overlap there.

The lit arc is only as long as the next plan is near. When the next plan is tomorrow it is about 13 degrees, a short bright stroke, which is honest but small. The afterglow wedge is visible but still subtle.
restaurant~seasonal is 4.4 ΔE under deuteranopia (guideline 5). The icons carry the difference.
The tubes' plastic still has a lighter top border on Plans, To do, Status and Settings (only Home's dial was dimmed). That is consistent across the page, but it is a grey highlight arc.
revisions: Home dial: rings moved in to r78 and the lit rim out to r96, so the arc clears the rings and the hand. The arc is a 4px core with the kit's three-layer halo plus a blurred halo stroke and a hot end dot. The afterglow wedge went from 22-28% to 14%→44%. The bezel's top highlight is dimmed to pewter at 40% and the sheen removed. Week labels sit inside the ring band at about 18px, in pewter-ink. The grid, track, hub ring and day ticks are pewter. Rings that are not next are steel-cyan; only the next ring is lit.

Green to ground: the ask box border is pewter at rest and phosphor only on focus. Column head links are in section ink. Heather is lifted to #a88ad0, seasonal moved to olive #a8a86c, and the accent changed to warm stone #cfc6b4. Home went from 73.2% to 68.1% green and Ideas from 70.0% to 59.7%. Every typical-sight colour floor passes.
Coming up: added the diary line 'SUN 4 OCT · in 2 days' in label caps with wheat figures, and dimmed rings that are not next to --plans at 60%.
Underlines removed at rest on 'Choose your own password', Plans' lede link and 'Change a key' (2px section ink on hover and focus).

Settings: the 'LOOK AT 1 PART' badge is replaced by a nine-segment parts ring (steel lit, the gap at Sign-in) reading '8 of 9 / in order' (new parts_ring macro in _ui.html). The strip's Sign-in cell is now a steel square plus amber 'Needs a look' words.

Ideas: the grid starts at the head, numerals lead the rows (VT323, heather), the map's labels fan on leader ticks and flip clear of the rim, and the rotating sweep is dropped. 'Save a thought for later' is a quiet key on the views bar. Dot hit areas were enlarged to keep 0 small targets.

Status: the meter has a 2px pewter track, a $0 label, a longer 1.5px dashed ghost at 55%, and '$0.00 TODAY' lifted into the lower third. Heads align with the rows' text edge, so folios and lamps share the margin column. All page tubes are one size.

Plans: a second lede line ('Then ...') fills the band beside the leaf. Past days' rings are pewter, grid numerals Outfit 300 tabular, and titles wrap to two lines. Fixed an inherited negative margin that was clipping every month title.
Form: 'New idea' at --t-page with the 32px heather square, and a 'Kinds so far' margin showing each kind's square, icon and ink (new idea_form.html in the variant).
To do: every page's tube is the same size, and 'TASKS' under the amber 3 is in amber-dim, so the whole LATE readout is one ink.
Phone: the mini tube says 'in 1 d' for tomorrow, so the word no longer overflows the glass.

Declined: making Kind a <select>. The page lets the family invent a kind (the model does too, and the page gives it a spark), and a closed select would remove that ability. The margin key gives the visual tie instead. Declined: plan chips in the kind's ink, because month entries carry no kind. Not done to the letter: the critic's 'fold Save a thought into the filter row's end'. It went onto the views bar directly above the filters instead, because the five-column filter row at 1fr/22rem has no room for a sixth control without squeezing the selects.
crit: Home, the dial's light does not report anything you can see in a still, though that is the whole point of this cross. The arc from 12 o'clock to ring 4 is about 26° and 3px, and it disappears under the hand and the ring. The 40° afterglow wedge is invisible. Thicken the lit arc to 4px, offset it about 6px outside the waypoint rings, and give it the kit's two-layer halo at full strength. Raise the conic wedge's start stop from 22% to about 38% phosphor so the sweep's persistence reads. Dim the bezel's grey highlight arc at upper left (it reads as a second lit arc) to --pewter at 40%. The week labels ('1w' crammed against ring 9, '3w' against 24) should go INSIDE the tick ring at 15-16px, not 14px against a ring.

Green share is still about 75%; the brief aimed at 55-60%. Move the big constant greens to ground. (a) The ask box's 1px phosphor border at rest (.ask / box outline) becomes --pewter #5d6469, turning phosphor only on :focus-within. (b) The dial's faint concentric grid and dashed guide rings go to pewter at 30%, so only the hand, the lit arc and the next ring glow. (c) Heather --ideas #a597b4 is too grey to read as colour: lift its chroma (about #a892c8) on the head square, the column cap and the strip label. (d) Set the 'all plans / all 4 / all 12' head links in their section ink, not bone.

Coming up rows lost the parent's diary-set date. The ring numeral now stands alone, and 'in 2 days' gives no weekday or month. Add a second line in --label caps, 'SUN 4 OCT · in 2 days' (wheat figures, tabular), so the rows keep the typesetting the lineage was praised for. Dim past or not-next rings to --plans at 60% and keep only ring 4 phosphor. Also remove the at-rest underlines the brief banned that remain on Home's setup link 'Choose your own password', on Plans' lede link 'Oaks Park roller rink' and on Status's 'Change a key': show them on :hover and :focus-visible only, 2px in the section ink.

Settings, the tube is still the old badge ('LOOK AT 1 PART' in green). It is the one circle that draws no data, and it lights green for a problem. Draw nine segments round the rim, one per part: eight steel #7f93a3 lit steadily and one dark gap at Sign-in's position. Put '8 of 9' in VT323 in the glass and 'in order' under it in --label. Settings then joins the one-window-per-page system and the green comes off a warning. The strip's 'SIGN-IN AND SECURITY' cell should carry the steel square plus 'needs a look' in amber words, like the row, not an all-amber caps label.

Ideas: the map's numbers do not tie to the rows. Each row's '#1' is 10px green at the far right edge, about 450px from the map, and the south-of-home cluster (1, 6, 8, 10) stacks its labels into one blob. Move the numeral to LEAD each row in VT323 at 15px, in --ideas, before the kind square. Fan the clustered map labels out on 6-10px leader ticks so each number and its 44px <a> sits clear. Drop the rotating sweep wedge on this map (an angle that reports nothing, the line's old failed reach), or tie it to the hovered row's bearing. Start the 1fr/22rem grid at the head so the sticky map's top fills the empty band right of 'Ideas'. Fold 'Save a thought for later' into the filter row's end, not a floating box above it.

Status: the meter's data marks are missing from the still. The ghost needle at the 30-day average ($0.04) cannot be seen, the arc track is barely visible, and $0 has no label. Draw the 240° track 2px pewter, label $0 at its start, and make the ghost needle 1.5px dashed at 55% phosphor, longer than the live one. Lift '$0.00 TODAY' off the glass's lower lip (it crowds the bezel) into the lower third, centred under the hub. The brief's folio column is not done: '01 Who answers' still sits inline. Put 01/02/03 in a 4.5rem left margin column (Outfit 300, 3rem, --faint), with the heads aligned to the rows' text edge.

Form (New idea) is the page where the system breaks. Its name is about 40px, not --t-page 64px; its ink square is 20px, not the 32px of every other page; Kind is still a free-text field. Set 'New idea' at --t-page with the full heather square. Make Kind a <select> whose options read 'ACTIVITY Roller rink…' style: the kind's word in caps and its ink as a 10px square in the field's left edge once one is chosen. Give the empty right half of the form the 'Only a title and a kind are needed' lede as a margin note, or cap the form at 62ch and centre it, rather than leaving 420px of ground.

Plans: there is still a dead band between the lede (y≈210) and the strip (y≈310) beside the leaf. Pull the strip up under the lede or give the lede a second line ('5 this month, 3 this week'). In the month grid, past rings (29 Sep, 1 Oct) look the same as future ones: draw past days' rings in pewter #5d6469 at 1px. Stop truncating chip titles ('Mount St. Helens day …'): wrap them to two lines at --t-small. The day numerals in the grid read heavier than the leaf's numeral; set them in Outfit 300, tabular.

firstDraft.name: Dessau, Dialled
firstDraft.concept: The line keeps its Bauhaus poster: a big sentence-case name, a square of section ink, one green primary and one round phosphor tube. Every circle now reports something real. On Home it is a true 28-day dial: now is at twelve o'clock, the angle is days out, and the rim is lit only from now to the next plan. On the other pages the circle is a leaf, a meter, an amber LATE or a map. Around the tubes the page is matte and grounded: section inks, wheat figures, clay for the family. The feel is a calm printed poster where the only light is the machine reporting.
